name: slider
summary: Picks a number on a scale with one thumb on a track, named by its field: the arrow keys move it one step, Page Up and Page Down a large step, Home and End to its ends, with read-only and disabled.

notCovered.name: the touch target
notCovered.why: Under a coarse pointer UI SDK lays an empty box 2.75rem each way over each thumb, so a tap near it reaches it. It draws nothing, so no light reads its size; at phone width the slider's control, where a press lands, is 2.75rem tall whatever the pointer.
